exam.title: Administering Information Security in Microsoft 365
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Purview administration plus familiarity with PowerShell, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender XDR, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps; hands-on experience with classification, sensitivity labels, DLP, endpoint controls, retention, Insider Risk Management, Audit, eDiscovery, and AI data security is strongly recommended.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Implement data loss prevention and retention

review.notes: Every July 28, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a data requirement, classifier, label, user/device/location context, preventive/detective control, priority, evidence, exception, failure, investigation, or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover built-in/custom SITs, fingerprinting, EDM, trainable classifiers, OCR and explorers; item/container labels, protection, publishing, auto-labeling and Cloud Apps; client/scanner and email encryption; unified and endpoint DLP, Adaptive Protection, precedence and just-in-time protection; retention labels/policies, adaptive scopes, Policy lookup, disposition and recovery; Insider Risk roles/connectors/Defender/signals/templates/policies/forensic evidence/risk levels/cases/notices; Audit, Activity Explorer, DLP/insider/XDR/Cloud Apps alerts and eDiscovery; and Microsoft/third-party AI protection with current versus classic DSPM terminology. All 24 URLs are cataloged: 23 reachable and the Udemy page automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records 20 hours 45 minutes of current Learn paths, four-day course, free Practice Assessment, current MeasureUp metadata, July 2026 gaps in older material, and the absence of independently verified exact Pluralsight, O'Reilly, or Whizlabs pages. September 17, 2026 lifecycle check: added the announced October revision and current date evidence to the guide and catalog. This is a bounded notice update; historical objective snapshot and full-review date remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md.

findings.title: Official revision dates conflict
findings.evidence: The published skills and change log say October 28, 2026; the certification overview says October 14.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Data Explorer includes individual classified items
findings.evidence: Current guidance distinguishes list and content viewer access and privileged content visibility.
findings.recommendation: Replace aggregate-only description and question; require role-specific evidence.
findings.resolution: Replace aggregate-only description and question; require role-specific evidence.

findings.title: JIT fallback controls classification failure
findings.evidence: Allow/Block fallback does not select initial JIT Block/Audit; JIT and global Endpoint DLP path exclusions have different effects.
findings.recommendation: Add initial/failure worked example and separate exclusions.
findings.resolution: Add initial/failure worked example and separate exclusions.

findings.title: Power BI label protection is not blanket access revocation
findings.evidence: In-service label-change rights differ from content permissions, separate protection policies and protected Desktop files.
findings.recommendation: Add worked example and verify service, file and export boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add worked example and verify service, file and export boundaries.

findings.title: Retention duration must be evaluated from its start date
findings.evidence: Ordinary retention conflict processing compares actual end dates; an explicit delete instruction does not cancel continuing retention.

findings.title: Audit record lifetime is determined at ingestion
findings.evidence: Custom retention priority can shorten the default and later changes do not extend previously committed records.
findings.recommendation: Teach generating-user license, priority and ingestion-time boundary.
findings.resolution: Teach generating-user license, priority and ingestion-time boundary.

findings.title: Priority cleanup is an exceptional destruction workflow
findings.evidence: August permanent-deletion preview can override holds/retention and bypass recycle bins but does not remove existing review-set copies.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded tabletop-only awareness with simulation and approval separation.
findings.resolution: Add bounded tabletop-only awareness with simulation and approval separation.

findings.title: Network DLP GA has integration and coverage limits
findings.evidence: Current network docs distinguish collection from inline enforcement, exclude B2B guests and document sizes/delays/provider differences.
findings.recommendation: Add current network route, limits and evidence caveats.
findings.resolution: Add current network route, limits and evidence caveats.
